absent: Persistence, caching, and inheritance logic of set_posix_acl and __get_acl including backing-store translation.
Name-to-type mapping and accepted names handled by posix_acl_type.
Authorization and post-operation behavior of security_inode_set_acl, security_inode_get_acl, security_inode_remove_acl, and related post hooks.
Delegation primitives try_break_deleg, break_deleg_wait, and is_delegated including error and retry semantics.
Identifier translation and size-query handling in vfs_set_acl_idmapped_mnt, posix_acl_from_xattr, and vfs_posix_acl_to_xattr.
Remainder of do_task_stat beyond the truncated fragment including final field order and formatting.
Name helpers wq_worker_comm, get_kthread_comm, get_task_comm, and memory escaper seq_escape_mem.
Sequence-file overflow recovery, growth policy, num_to_str, and hex_asc table.
Speculation control query arch_prctl_spec_ctrl_get with PR_SPEC value meanings.
Memory helpers get_mm_counter_sum, mm_pgtables_bytes, hugetlb_report_usage, and NOMMU region sharing rules.
Locking and lifetime for dentry, inode, cred, pid namespace, file table, and mm objects outside the shown critical sections.
CPU mask formatting via cpumask_pr_args and cpuset output via cpuset_task_status_allowed.

findings.text: Privileged installer vfs_set_acl accepts a mount identity map with a dentry plus a name and an optional in-memory object. It rejects unknown names with EINVAL, translates identifiers for idmapped mounts when an object is present, then performs a locked update that checks inode writability and a pre hook and delegation state before asking persistence to store. Success triggers notification and a post hook, whereas failure preserves the observed error apart from delegation retry.

Reader vfs_get_acl accepts a mount identity map with a dentry plus a name and returns an owned object or an error pointer. It rejects unknown names with EINVAL, consults a read authorization hook first, requires POSIX ACL support, refuses symbolic links, then looks up the entry. Absent entries yield ENODATA whereas EOPNOTSUPP signals unsupported cases.

Remover vfs_remove_acl mirrors installation but clears rather than stores. It validates the name with EINVAL on failure, checks inode writability under lock, consults a distinct pre-remove hook, handles delegations identically, asks persistence to clear the named type, and on success runs notification plus a distinct post-remove hook.

Adapters do_set_acl with do_get_acl connect byte buffers and in-memory objects. The set direction parses nonempty input into a temporary object and forwards it, or forwards null when size is zero, then releases the temporary. The get direction fetches an owned object, serializes it into the caller buffer respecting size, then releases it. Parse or lookup failures propagate without further action.

Composer proc_pid_status builds the per-task status document. It always emits a name line first, then identity fields, then memory plus dumping plus huge-page plus tag-mask details only when an address space is available, followed by signal masks and capabilities and privilege speculation data and processor affinity and cpuset data and switch counts and an architecture hook.

Visible first half of collector do_task_stat gathers inputs for the numeric stat record under execution-update and sighand protection. It snapshots exit status with state letter and memory size and terminal identity and thread count and handler-derived masks and resource limits and namespace-relative identifiers and cumulative counters, gating instruction plus stack plus wait-channel exposure on permission and selecting whole-group aggregation when requested.

Checker may_write_xattr denies mutation with EPERM when the inode is immutable or append-only or carries identifiers unmapped in the mount, and otherwise allows the caller to proceed. It is the only filesystem-object restriction applied by the privileged ACL mutation paths.

Output helpers seq_put_decimal_ull with seq_put_decimal_ull_width and seq_put_hex_ll append delimited numerals to sequential output. The unsized decimal form forwards with zero width. Sized forms emit an optional delimiter, enforce a minimum width where zero means one for decimal, compute digits without overrunning, and mark overflow when room is insufficient.

Namer proc_task_name chooses among workqueue worker identity checked via PF_WQ_WORKER versus kernel-thread identity via PF_KTHREAD versus ordinary command name, using a 64 byte scratch area, then either escapes spacing and special characters or emits a truncated name. Escaper seq_escape_str forwards a string with its measured length to a memory escaper. Resolver seq_user_ns returns the opener credential namespace when namespaces exist and the initial namespace otherwise.

All privileged ACL paths resolve the supplied name before locking or authorization, so unknown names fail with EINVAL without side effects. Install translates mount-specific identifiers to global identifiers before first lock acquisition when an object is supplied, allowing later caching and backing-store handling to use global values.

Reads enforce only a security hook plus support checks, whereas mutations additionally require inode writability. Unsupported filesystems with symbolic links fail reads with EOPNOTSUPP, missing entries fail with ENODATA, unwritable inodes fail mutations with EPERM, and bad inodes fail mutations with EIO.

Notification with post hooks occur only after persistence reports success. Validation failures plus writability denials plus pre-hook denials plus delegation errors plus persistence errors skip both follow-ups. The delegation-retry path is the sole case that discards an intermediate success marker and restarts.

Install with remove acquire inode_lock before writability checks and hold it through pre hooks plus delegation try-break plus bad-inode testing plus persistence, then release via inode_unlock before any delegation wait. A recorded delegation is waited upon unlocked, and only a successful wait restarts the locked section from the top.

Status sampling uses short nested critical sections. Identity collection holds RCU during reads of tracer plus parent plus credential plus namespace plus file-table state and a task lock for filesystem plus descriptor fields. Capability sampling holds RCU for credential copies. Signal sampling holds the sighand lock during copies of pending plus shared plus blocked plus handler-derived plus count plus limit state. NOMMU accounting holds the address-space read lock across area walks. Stat collection holds a killable execution-update read lock plus the sighand lock plus RCU with a statistics sequence lock for cumulative counters.

Sequential output behaves as a cursor with a byte store plus a fill count plus a capacity plus an overflow mark. Appenders test remaining room before delimiters and digits, advance the fill count only on success, and set the overflow mark instead of partial writes when capacity would be exceeded.

Mutation cycles among attempt and delegated and wait and retry. A locked attempt may record a delegation rather than fail. After unlock the recorded item is waited upon. Successful waits transition back to a fresh locked attempt, whereas wait failures or unrelated errors terminate with the observed result.

Status generation follows name then identity then an optional memory branch then signals then capabilities then privilege speculation then affinity then cpuset then switch counts then architecture hook. The memory branch is taken only when an address-space reference is obtained, otherwise the flow proceeds directly from identity to signals.

Numeric appenders convert shortage into overflow rather than truncation. Decimal logic reserves room up front and rechecks after delimiters plus width handling, treating zero width as one. Hexadecimal logic derives digit count from the highest set bit with zero needing one digit, pads to the requested width, and overflows when padded length would exceed capacity.

High-water memory figures take the maximum of live totals and stored maxima because stored values update only when lowering totals, so concurrent snapshots may mix generations. Instruction with stack pointers remain zero unless the reader is permitted and the target is exiting or dumping, sampled under a stack guard. Wait-channel exposure is limited to permitted single-thread-equivalent views. Terminal plus handler plus limit reads occur under the sighand lock.

Set adapters always release the parsed temporary after forwarding, and get adapters always release the fetched object after serialization, on both success and failure. Null on the install path skips translation and requests clearing, so callers must test for error pointers before forwarding to distinguish parse failure from intentional clearing.

State labels pair a leading character with a word in fixed order. Early entries associate R with running and S with sleeping and D with disk sleep and T with stopped and small t with tracing stop. The leading character also supplies the single-letter state consumed by the stat collector.

Later entries associate X with dead and Z with zombie and P with parked, followed beyond the report range by I with idle. Status output shows the selected pair after a State tag, and build-time validation ties table length to the report maximum.

Identity fields appear in stable order. An optional octal Umask line precedes State, then decimal Tgid and Ngid and Pid and PPid and TracerPid, then four mapped values for Uid and four for Gid, then decimal FDSize, then a Groups list with trailing space, then optional per-namespace rows NStgid and NSpid and NSpgid and NSsid, then a numeric Kthread flag.

Signal with capability fields use stable tags. Decimal Threads with SigQ as used over limit precede hexadecimal masks SigPnd and ShdPnd and SigBlk and SigIgn and SigCgt. Capabilities follow as fixed-width hexadecimal CapInh and CapPrm and CapEff and CapBnd and CapAmb.

Privilege with placement fields follow capabilities. Numeric NoNewPrivs with optional Seccomp and Seccomp_filters precede two speculation lines Speculation_Store_Bypass and SpeculationIndirectBranch using enumerated phrases, then affinity masks Cpus_allowed and Cpus_allowed_list, then counts voluntary_ctxt_switches and nonvoluntary_ctxt_switches, plus flags CoreDumping and THP_enabled and untag_mask.

Paging memory counters are kilobyte scaled with minimum width eight in fixed order. The leading group covers VmPeak and VmSize and VmLck and VmPin and VmHWM and VmRSS and RssAnon and RssFile and RssShmem. High-water entries report the maximum of live and stored values.

The trailing paging group covers VmData and VmStk and VmExe and VmLib and VmPTE and VmSwap followed by huge-page usage. Executable bytes split between text and library using aligned code bounds capped by executable pages. NOMMU output instead gives byte-exact Mem and Slack and Shared. Signal sets render as high-to-low hexadecimal nibbles terminated by newline.
